strings.Càng cao càng dễ bắt đầu tiếng yếu so vớ: Higher sensitivity detects weaker onsets relative to the strongest hit in each lane. Hits must still exceed the dBFS threshold; this is not detection confidence.

strings.Tăng/giảm đầu tiếng trên toàn stem Drums: Boost/reduce attack across the entire Drums stem, including cymbals and layered samples. This is not a volume percentage; excessive boost can make hi-hats harsh.

strings.Tỷ lệ trộn nhánh nén mạnh (−28 dB, 8:1,: Blend of heavy compression (−28 dB, 8:1, +6 dB makeup). Adds body and density but can raise background noise and reduce dynamic contrast.
strings.Tỷ lệ trộn tín hiệu nén 3 dải, mốc 180 H: Blend of three-band compression with crossovers at 180 Hz / 4 kHz. The compressed branch uses a −24 dB threshold and 3:1 ratio. 25% blends 25% compressed and 75% pre-stage signal.

strings.Ứng dụng Windows để chỉnh audio, tách nh: A native Windows application for audio processing, instrument separation and drum remixing. Features stereo processing, AI stem separation, six DrumSep lanes, sample layering, MIDI export, lyric transcription and WAV/FLAC export. Audio is processed locally; public downloads, engine installation and model downloads need Internet.
